title: Rippers Unmasked — Guise
description: The Guise (mask / identity swap) as a first-class Project FU classFeature, on the Arcanist Arcanum pattern: hold several guises, bind one to make it active (dismissing any other), and its embedded ActiveEffect deltas apply on swap. Registers 'guise' on FU's module-open classFeature registry — no system fork. Original campaign content. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

rippers-guise.note: v0.7.4 (ROS-24, Austin's v0.7.3 review): (1) PERK is now FREE TEXT — the curated 21-perk grid is gone; the player writes the perk in prose (like Tell/Bane/flaw/Nature). (2) D-BONUS is a NARRATIVE scope, not a mechanical check type — the Open/Opposed/Group selector is removed; the player writes the circumstance the +3 applies to (e.g. 'when acting to protect a child') and the GM applies it. No mechanical-type gating, no ActiveEffect; shown in Review as '+3 to [descriptor] (GM-applied)'. This supersedes the v0.7.2 D-Bonus framing (the Specialty die-bump's magic/accuracy exclusion is unchanged). (3) SKILL-LEVEL CAP BUG FIXED — the per-skill max SL was enforced at compile/create but the SKILLS-step number input let you TYPE past it (the HTML max attribute does not block manual entry) and displayed the over-max value, so it read as 'no limit'. The input now CLAMPS to the skill's max SL on entry, the display clamps too, and validateGuiseDraft additionally BLOCKS Create if any skill exceeds its max. Regression tests added. Tests 48/48. --- v0.7.3 (ROS-24): added a one-click Specialty ARM/DISARM button on the character sheet's guises panel (shown only when the character has Specialties on their Innate Guise) — arms the die-bump for the next Open/skill Check without a macro; turns green while armed. Ritual checks stay ELIGIBLE (Austin: only magic/accuracy/display excluded). --- v0.7.2 (ROS-24): D-Bonus RULED — Austin ruled the +3 Bonus follows the same rule as Specialties, so it must NOT apply to Accuracy or Magic checks. The selector is now Open / Opposed / Group ONLY (Accuracy + Magic dropped); all GM-situational, so there is NO ActiveEffect — the +3 is stored/labelled data the GM applies at the table. --- v0.7.1 (ROS-24 follow-up): (1) HUNTER WEAPON authoring in Innate mode — a fieldset to drag a weapon Item as the Hunter Weapon plus a material selector (silver/cold_iron/consecrated/wood/cursed → the bane key) and an origin; on create the weapon is materialised as a character-owned Item and marked via setHunterWeapon. (2) SPECIALTY die-bump automation — the two Specialties live on the Innate guise; a player arms armSpecialtyDieBump(actor) for their next check and FU's prepareCheck hook improves ONE attribute die a size, EXCLUDING Magic and Accuracy checks (Austin's ruling), restored in processCheck. D-Bonus stays provisional/data-only (held pending Austin). Tests 43/43. ⚠ the die-bump raises actor.system.attributes[attr].current transiently in prepareCheck (FU builds the roll die from .current at roll time) — verify live on FU 4.16.2 that the bump survives to the roll and restores. --- v0.7.0 GUISE-BUILDER-FIX (ROS-24): the Builder was under-constrained (every affinity could be Absorption) and missing core fields. Guardrails now enforced: EXACTLY 3 distinct classes (Q4); the affinity TRIO — one Immunity + one Vulnerability + one Resistance, an Immunity MUST be paired with a Vulnerability, and ABSORPTION IS NEVER OFFERED (Q6/Q7); the un-canon 'Governing skill' + 'Max forms collectable' monstrous controls are REMOVED (Q7). Missing fields wired: Guise Equipment (was hardcoded []), Perk (curated list), a +3 Bonus with a check-type selector (Q3 — PROVISIONAL taxonomy: Accuracy/Magic/Open/Opposed/Group; Austin to confirm/adjust live), a narrative Bane (Q2), a Tell, a narrative flaw, and a plain-text Nature (Q5). NEW Innate-Guise mode (Q1): two Specialties + one creation Heroic (creation-banned heroics refused), no armour/hands/affinities/perk/tell — a worn guise never carries a Heroic. 6-step wizard (Identity/Classes/Skills/Loadout/Affinities/Review). Headless tests 37/37. Registers a first-class 'guise' classFeature (Arcanum pattern) via CONFIG.FU.classFeatureRegistry. No FU content redistributed.
